messages:
ops-oncall: :rotating_light: West3 control plane auth errors — multiple teams reporting 401s from console and config rollout jobs failing. Observed ~10% of API routed traffic failing to authenticate. Root event: controlplane-west3 heartbeat gap to config-store at 03:02 UTC.

maria: seeing spikes in proxy errors too: `503 upstream read timeout` from auth-proxy pods in west3. Console sessions timing out.

jon: confirming, reproducer: curl to /v1/configs returns 502 with `upstream connection refused`. Logs from auth-service show repeated `etcd: leader not found`.

sujay: tagging infra-oncall @ops-oncall — is this a leader election problem or network partition?

ops-oncall: good call. Initial triage: control plane nodes in west3 lost quorum with config-store (etcd) after a noisy network flapping event between two AZs. BGP metrics show peer drops starting at 03:01:45 UTC.

amelia: rolling back recent config rollout? We had a canary earlier that touched cert refresh settings ~02:50 UTC.

dmitri: cert-change looks unrelated. Packet drops correlate with a fabric switch firmware anomaly flagged by cloud provider for west3-A. Provider is throttling reboots.

ops-oncall: immediate mitigation plan: 1) Pause all control-plane config rollouts in west3 (set gating flag). 2) Shift API traffic away from west3 to eu-west1 and us-west2 by adjusting smart-routing weight. 3) Promote standby control-plane in eu-west1 for critical auth paths. 4) Increase etcd election timeout as temporary measure.

jon: executing step 1 — `curl -X POST https://ops-api/flags/pause-rollouts -d '{"region":"west3"}'` -> 200 OK.

maria: starting traffic shift: updating routing policy to lower west3 weight to 0.2 from 1.0. Using routerctl: `routerctl set-weight west3 0.2 --reason "controlplane auth errors"`

infra-bot: action logged: routerctl set-weight west3 0.2 by maria at 03:07:12 UTC.

ops-oncall: step 3: failover auth-sensitive endpoints to eu-west1 control-plane. Note: eu-west1 has capacity but higher p99 latency for some customers. We'll route only critical auth and console traffic for admins. Non-critical traffic to low-priority pool.

sujay: starting standby-promotion runbook: `cg-promote --source eu-west1 --target west3-standby` (dry run first).

dmitri: provider reports west3-A fabric scheduled maintenance causing intermittent control-plane NIC resets. They estimate 30-45 mins.

amelia: console SSO token refresh failures are rate-limited; we should extend token TTL for admins via temporary override so they can access console during failover.

ops-oncall: done — admin TTL extended to 2h for west3 by applying `auth-config override ttl_admin 7200 --region west3` (audit: ticket INC-1782).

jon: attempting increase of etcd election timeout to reduce flapping: patch applied to control-plane manifest: `ETCD_ELECTION_TIMEOUT=5000` -> rolling restart queued. Observed partial recovery after first restart in west3-B.

maria: monitoring metrics: auth success rate climbing from 88% -> 97% for admin routing, overall API auth at 93%. Console sessions still flaky for a subset of users in west3-A.

ops-oncall: can we get more capacity if provider takes >45 mins? Cost discussion: moving sustained traffic to eu-west1 raises cross-region egress cost. We should limit prolonged failover.

sujay: propose to enable temporary burst nodes in west3-C using spare reserved GPUs for dedicated control-plane tasks to reduce cross-region failover. This will incur intra-region charges but cheaper than cross-region egress.

dmitri: provider won't guarantee new nodes until fabric maintenance completes. We can spin up warm standby in us-west2 as fallback, but that also has egress.

ops-oncall: action items: - Maintain routing weight change and monitor 5m aggregates. - Keep rollouts paused in west3. - Continue etcd timeout tweak and monitor leader stability. - Notify customers via status.redwood.ai with targeted message for west3 impacts. - Prepare runbook for full region failover if provider extends maintenance.

maria: drafted status update: "We are investigating authentication errors affecting services in west3; traffic has been shifted and console access for admins restored. No impact to model serving for most customers. Updates every 15 minutes." Please review quick.

jon: lgtm, add note about config rollouts paused and ETA for next update.

ops-oncall: notifying support and SRE rotations. @maria please publish status and pin. @dmitri please keep comms with provider.

infra-bot: incident INC-17901 created and auto-tagged severity:high. Pager duty notified.

maria: status posted to status page at 03:18 UTC. Customers alerted to webhooks.

ops-oncall: monitoring: if auth error rate >5% for >15m then trigger full region failover (manual). Next check in 10 mins.

jon: logs snippet from auth-service at 03:20:30 UTC: ```ERROR auth: rpc dial tcp 10.12.5.3:2379: connect: connection timed out
WARN etcdclient: no leader for 2s
INFO auth: fallback to standby for token validation```

sujay: update: leader stable for 2 consecutive elections after restart, but jitter persists near 03:23.

ops-oncall: closing loop for now: we're keeping rollouts paused, routing weights lowered, admin console TTL extended, and provider says maintenance might finish by 03:50 UTC. Will escalate if extended.

maria: will post follow-up once provider confirms completion. :white_check_mark:
